dashboard.label: Profile Generation Operations
dashboard.description: Orders, failures and SLA risk from simgen events (lab data).

search.query: index=main sourcetype=_json event=order_received | stats dc(order_id) as received
index=main sourcetype=_json event=order_completed | stats dc(order_id) as delivered
index=main sourcetype=_json event IN (order_failed, order_rejected) | stats count as failures

panel.title: Open orders and hours left to SLA

search.query: index=main sourcetype=_json event IN (order_received, order_completed, order_failed) | stats latest(event) as last_event, latest(due_at) as due_at, values(customer) as customer, values(batch) as batch by order_id | where last_event="order_received" | eval hours_left=round((strptime(due_at, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") - now()) / 3600, 1) | sort hours_left | table order_id customer batch due_at hours_left
index=main sourcetype=_json event IN (order_failed, order_rejected) | stats count by error_code | sort - count
index=main sourcetype=_json event IN (order_received, order_completed, order_failed, order_rejected) | timechart span=1h count by event

index=main sourcetype=_json event=order_completed | stats count as orders, sum(quantity) as cards, avg(duration_ms) as avg_ms, perc95(duration_ms) as p95_ms, sum(eval(if(sla_met="false",1,0))) as sla_breaches by customer | eval avg_ms=round(avg_ms)
index=main sourcetype=_json event IN (worker_started, worker_error, claim_requeued) | stats count, latest(_time) as last_seen by node, event | convert ctime(last_seen)
